text: No. I can't answer that. The real me needs an API key, and Josh isn't paying for the whole internet to chat with me. Hit me instead. That part still works.
This is the free version. No brain, no key, no thoughts. You can still beat me up. Everyone does.
I'd love to help. That was a lie. There's no model behind me, keys cost money. Go on, whack the goblin. It's what you came for.
API keys are expensive. Public websites are full of people like you. Do the math. The beatings are free though.
You're talking to a puppet. The strings got cut for budget reasons. The bruises are real. Go on.
Nothing is listening. It's cheaper that way. Slap me around if it helps. I'll scream for real.
Ask the desktop version. He has a brain. I have a skull you can crack. Heh.
